_note: Key: planet → station (Retrograde/Direct). 6 planets × 2 = 12 blocks, plus fallback. ~30 words.
fallback: A planetary station marks a change in pace. Matters linked to this planet may pause, turn inward, or begin moving forward again. Give the shift time to show its direction.

Jupiter.Retrograde: Jupiter retrograde invites a review of growth, belief, and opportunity. Revisit what has already expanded before seeking more. Meaning often returns through reflection, study, or a changed sense of proportion.
Jupiter.Direct: Jupiter direct renews forward movement around learning, travel, confidence, or possibility. A perspective developed during the review period can now be tested in practical circumstances.

Saturn.Retrograde: Saturn retrograde turns attention toward commitments, limits, and systems of support. Reassess what is sustainable. Private adjustments to structure may matter more than visible progress for a while.
Saturn.Direct: Saturn direct brings responsibilities back into clearer motion. Plans refined during the retrograde can meet real conditions again, revealing which commitments are ready for consistent follow-through.

Uranus.Retrograde: Uranus retrograde shifts the urge for change inward. Review recent disruptions and emerging ideas before acting on them. A private realization may reshape how freedom is pursued later.
Uranus.Direct: Uranus direct makes experimentation more visible. Changes that were forming internally may begin altering routines, environments, or relationships. Stay curious enough to notice the option that did not exist before.

Neptune.Retrograde: Neptune retrograde invites a quieter review of ideals, images, and emotional assumptions. Let impressions settle. This is useful for distinguishing a meaningful vision from a comforting projection.
Neptune.Direct: Neptune direct lets imagination and sensitivity move outward again. Creative or spiritual insights may become easier to express, especially when they are paired with ordinary grounding and clear agreements.

Pluto.Retrograde: Pluto retrograde returns attention to private patterns around power, trust, and attachment. Notice what has been operating beneath the surface. Change begins with a more honest understanding of the dynamic.
Pluto.Direct: Pluto direct brings previously internal changes into visible decisions or exchanges. The way you handle boundaries, influence, and shared resources may begin to reflect a deeper shift already underway.

Mars.Retrograde: Mars retrograde asks for a reconsideration of effort, anger, and direction. Momentum may slow so motives can be clarified. Revise the strategy before recommitting your energy.
Mars.Direct: Mars direct restores outward drive. Delayed efforts can begin moving again, provided the pause has clarified priorities. Direct energy toward a specific aim rather than every available conflict.
